name: lbvh_default
_comment: maxDepth raised 12 -> 22 on 2026-08-16, same defect as kdtree_default: a BINARY structure capped at depth 12 has at most 2^12 = 4096 leaves regardless of point count, so leafCapacity never bound above ~131k points and this default was measured as a depth cap rather than as a LBVH. At 22 levels (4.2M leaves) leafCapacity binds through the whole searched ladder (1M-100M).
